segments.caption: A motocross rider, viewed from a helmet-mounted camera, accelerates down a narrow urban street lined with spectators and barriers, navigating a tight course with a Red Bull-branded bike as they race toward the next section of the track.
A motorcyclist races down a steep, narrow urban street, viewed from a helmet-mounted camera, as crowds line the sides behind barriers and a safety officer directs traffic.

A first-person view from a mountain biker’s helmet camera as they speed down a narrow, dirt-lined street lined with spectators, then transition onto a concrete staircase, and finally ride along a paved path, all while maintaining high speed and control.
A first-person view from a motorcycle racer speeding through a narrow, urban street course, navigating past crowds of spectators, barriers, and tight corners under bright daylight.

A rider speeds down a narrow, sunlit street lined with cheering crowds, navigating a tight course between buildings and barriers, with the Red Bull-branded helmet-mounted camera capturing the high-speed, adrenaline-fueled descent.

A first-person view from a mountain biker’s helmet camera captures a high-speed descent through a narrow, urban street lined with spectators behind barriers, transitioning from a gritty alley with graffiti to a paved road, all while maintaining a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled pace.

A first-person view from a speeding rally car navigates a narrow, cobblestoned street lined with cheering spectators behind barriers, passing a "NISSAN" branded ramp before continuing through tight urban turns.

A first-person view from a speeding motorcycle races through a narrow, crowded urban street, passing pedestrians and photographers as it navigates a sharp turn, with a Red Bull logo visible on the front.
